title: Python Worker Memory Retention & Docling Extraction Spikes
impactDescription: Heavy document parsing with Docling/PyTorch causes temporary RSS memory spikes up to 1.18 GB. After job completion, CPython process pool retains ~620 MB RSS due to heap allocator fragmentation and PyTorch memory cache, rather than releasing it to the OS.

title: LLM Model Inference & Context Processing Latency
impactDescription: P95 RAG response latency of 1,650 ms is dominated by model token generation and prompt context formatting in the LLM provider layer. Proxy and network transit overhead is minimal (<2ms).

title: CPython Runtime & Heavy Dependency Tree Import Latency
impactDescription: Initializing standalone Python 3.12 and importing FastAPI, Pydantic, SurrealDB SDK, and PyTorch dependency modules consumes ~650 ms of the total 1,100 ms API readiness startup window.

title: SurrealDB HNSW Vector Similarity & Hybrid Search Disk I/O
impactDescription: P95 vector search latency is 42 ms for hybrid keyword/vector retrieval over 100k document chunk embeddings stored in embedded SurrealDB tables.

title: Optional Extraction Package Disk Footprint (Docling / PyTorch)
impactDescription: When optional Docling extraction addon package is installed, site-packages size increases by ~350 MB (from 68 MB core to 418 MB full).
